steps: npm audit --json in backend/ and frontend-next/.
title: Dependency-audit ignore list is stale and one justification is inaccurate
expected: Ignored advisories are reviewed, still relevant, and removed once a fix exists.
actual: GHSA-mrwp-f3q8-3g9p (follow-redirects, high) is ignored in both packages, yet npm reports a fix available; the frontend note calls it a dev/build dependency, but axios is a frontend runtime dependency (the browser adapter does not load follow-redirects, so real exposure is low). The two DOMPurify 'critical' ignores no longer match any advisory (frontend audit: 0 critical). Current totals — backend: 1 high, 17 moderate, 4 low; frontend: 1 high, 10 moderate. GitHub also reports 8 Dependabot alerts on main.
impact: Stale ignores hide new advisories with the same ID and make the gate less trustworthy.
fix: Update axios/follow-redirects (npm audit fix), drop resolved ignore entries, add an expiry date to each remaining entry, and review the 8 Dependabot alerts.
